name: Windows
title: ClipDiff for Windows
setup: The Windows repository has the current install and update instructions. Extract the whole release ZIP and keep ClipDiff.exe beside ClipDiff.ShellExtension.dll. The self-contained build includes its .NET runtime.
fileSetup: ClipDiff adds the Explorer commands while it is running and Monitor Clipboard is enabled. On Windows 11, look under Show more options.
singleFile: The command appears once ClipDiff has a current capture. Clearing that capture removes the command; pausing or quitting removes both Explorer commands.
twoFiles: ClipDiff must already be running and monitoring. No previous capture is needed, and no administrator setup is required.
viewers: WinMerge, Beyond Compare, Meld, or Visual Studio Code
